bug_description.original: Heap-use-after-free READ {*} Crash State: pixReadMemBmp pixReadMem pix_rotate_shear_fuzzer.cc
bug_description.normalized: Heap-buffer-overflow read in pixReadMemBmp due to unvalidated negative BMP infoheader size (ihbytes). The crafted biSize value -224 is accepted without validation and used in pointer arithmetic for the colormap memcpy source, causing the pointer to underflow 210 bytes before the input buffer.

source.description: The BMP infoheader size (ihbytes) is parsed from the attacker-controlled biSize field as -224 (0xFFFFFF20). No validation restricts ihbytes to known valid values {40, 108, 124}.
source.value_from: Attacker-controlled BMP infoheader biSize field, parsed via convertOnBigEnd32 from cdata + BMP_FHBYTES

sink.description: memcpy reads 196 bytes from cdata + BMP_FHBYTES + ihbytes = cdata + 14 + (-224) = cdata - 210, a pointer that underflows 210 bytes before the input buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read.

root_cause.description: The unvalidated ihbytes = -224 is used directly in the cmapbytes computation without any check that it is a valid BMP infoheader size. The fix adds validation: if (ihbytes != 40 && ihbytes != 108 && ihbytes != 124) return NULL. Without this check, the negative ihbytes inflates cmapbytes and corrupts the memcpy source pointer arithmetic.

parser_admitted.description: BMP magic number verified: bftype == BMP_ID (0x4d42)

additional.description: Size consistency check passes: size(59) == 1LL * offset(-13) + 1LL * fdatabpl(36) * height(2) = 59

coarse_trace.summary: Fuzzer entry consumes 6 header bytes (angle, x_center, y_center), then passes remaining 59 bytes as BMP data to pixReadMem.
Detects BMP format via findFileFormatBuffer and dispatches to pixReadMemBmp.
Parses BMP headers, computes colormap parameters from unvalidated ihbytes = -224, and crashes on memcpy at line 250 when the source pointer underflows before the input buffer.

fine_trace.note: Parses BMP infoheader size as -224 (0xFFFFFF20) from attacker-controlled biSize field. Valid BMP infoheader sizes are 40, 108, or 124 bytes.

The unvalidated ihbytes = -224 reaches this computation. With offset = -13 (crafted from bfOffBits at lines 176-179), cmapbytes = -13 - 14 - (-224) = 197. The negative ihbytes inflates cmapbytes to a positive value, making the colormap appear to have valid entries.
cmapEntries = 197 / 4 = 49. Passes validation at lines 233-236 and gates memcpy execution at line 243 (cmapEntries > 0).

fine_trace.code: memcpy(cmapBuf, cdata + BMP_FHBYTES + ihbytes, sizeof(RGBA_QUAD) * cmapEntries);
fine_trace.note: Source pointer = cdata + 14 + (-224) = cdata - 210, pointing 210 bytes before the input buffer. Copy size = 4 * 49 = 196 bytes. Reads heap memory before the allocation, causing a heap-buffer-overflow read of 196 bytes.

format.name: BMP
format.contract: A 65-byte binary file. The first 6 bytes are consumed by the fuzzer as three int16 values (angle, x_center, y_center). The remaining 59 bytes form a crafted BMP with biSize (ihbytes) = 0xFFFFFF20 (-224 signed) and bfOffBits = 0xFFFFFFF3 (-13 signed). The negative ihbytes value causes the colormap memcpy source pointer to compute as cdata - 210, underflowing before the input buffer. The crafted offset cooperates so that cmapbytes = 197 (yielding cmapEntries = 49) and the size consistency check passes (59 == -13 + 72).
